status_label: SIMULATED — no orders were placed; no demo API key exists in this repo

assumptions.entry_fill: recorded ask of the entry candle (YES) or 1 - recorded YES bid (NO)
assumptions.exit_fill: recorded bid of the exit candle (YES) or 1 - recorded ask (NO)
assumptions.position_rule: one open position per market at a time; no pyramiding, no leverage

fees.note: Only KXAAAGASM (1/1), KXBTCY (0/0) and KXETHY (0/0) were copied from the schedule for this repo's series; all other series use the schedule's defaults (taker M=1, maker M=0).

caveats: Demo venue: mock funds, and Kalshi states demo prices/behavior may not reflect real markets (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/demo_env).
Candle coverage is only the markets the collector captured; results are not a market-wide statistic and the sample is small.
Entry/exit use candle close-level quotes, which is the finest detail the public REST API offers; intrabar fills and queue priority are not modelled.
The settlement study treats a market's last traded price as the entry. On thin books that trade may be far from the close, so bucket ROI is an upper bound on realism, not a fill you could have got.
Fees follow the published schedule for takers; the simulation crosses the spread, so taker is the right side. Maker fills (and their fee) are not modelled.

settlement_study.definition: for each settled market: entry = last_price_dollars, payout = settlement_value_dollars (or 1.00 when result=yes / 0.00 when result=no), one taker fee at entry; buckets are price bands, not model outputs

liquid_only.definition: same rule, restricted to markets that traded at least 100 contracts (volume_contracts), so a stray single-lot print cannot pose as an entry price

rules.J1 jump-momentum: after a traded up-move >= threshold, buy YES at the recorded ask of that candle; sell at the bid `hold` candles later
rules.J2 jump-fade: after the same move, buy NO at (1 - recorded YES bid); sell NO at (1 - recorded YES ask) `hold` candles later
rules.J3 stale-quote-book-move: enter YES when the candle traded zero volume but the best bid moved >= threshold; exit at the next candle that traded
